prompt: What is the purpose of custom readObject() and writeObject() methods?
choices: To control exactly how the object's state is written and read during serialization
To define which fields are transient
To enable serialization of final classes
explanation: Declaring private void writeObject(ObjectOutputStream oos) and readObject(ObjectInputStream ois) lets you customize serialization logic — encrypt sensitive fields, validate state on deserialization, or serialize computed values. The JVM calls these methods instead of the default mechanism.
